title: 지형별 duty -> 정상 직진 속도, 출발 지연, 놓은 뒤 미끄러짐 (2026년 10월 기록)

source.vehicle: October 2026, before the steering unit, ESP8266 controller (differential drive, firmware drive ramp 100 %/s); manual driving records of 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-10
source.speed_reference: LiDAR scan matching (offline ICP) unless the value says GNSS; never checked with a tape; the references differ by 3-10 %
source.not_measured: The steering vehicle (ESP32-S3 with BTS7960 drivers, no drive ramp in its firmware, the steering unit's weight) has not been measured. Every value here is the old vehicle's.

duty_meaning: duty % = the bridge's throttle %; PWM = (duty * 255 + 50) // 100 (the bridge's own cap max_pwm applies on top)

grades.측정: 5 or more steady segments (or measured events)
grades.모델: a formula of the analysis, not a measurement
grades.가정: a measured value used for a case it was not measured in

terrains.label: 도로·포장
terrains.note: brick sidewalk, asphalt road and bike path (camera samples checked)

terrains.label: 과수원
terrains.note: one orchard terrain since 2026-11-20 (operator request; before: orchard_1003, orchard_row_1010, orchard_other_1010). Duty 45-70: the 2026-10-03 orchard (no trajectory to tell row from outside; 55 and 70 rest on GNSS). Duty 90 and 100: the 2026-10-10 rows inside and outside the catalogued corridors, the segment-weighted mean of the two LiDAR values. Not merged in: the 2026-10-03 duty 100 by GNSS (0.847 m/s, 3 segments). Each row lists the source rows it was made of (parts).

not_merged.why: GNSS reference, 3 segments, against 197 LiDAR segments of 2026-10-10

start.note: starts from a stop were requested at 88-100 % only; no start at 30-60 % from a stop was recorded

model.check: measured / model p10 0.91, p50 0.97, p90 1.16 (8 releases at 0.77-0.98 m/s)

release_coast.note: the old firmware ramped the duty down at 100 %/s on a key release; the ESP32 firmware cuts the drive at once ('2 S'); STOP braking and slow stops were never measured
